Bragg-peak segmentation on peaknet10k: proof report

Six segmentation statements (peaknet_baseline, hf_segformer, hf_upernet, lucid_segformer, lucid_unet, best_model) trained on the shared run-level split and evaluated on the whole test split (1529 images) with the shared metric code (test peak F1 at 3 px tolerance; pixel IoU second). Best so far: best_model at test peak F1 0.9061. Every figure on this page was rendered on S3DF from real checkpoints, predictions and logs; nothing was captured on any other machine.

based onsmp_unet (h7 run smp_r34_a, step-6000 best.pt snapshot)

EARLY landing (lead ORDER 14) on a snapshot of a still-running run: best.pt at step 6000 (val peak F1 0.917 on 150 val images at thr 0.9 in-training). Threshold re-picked by seg.evaluate on every 3rd val image (488 imgs) over 0.5..0.995 -> 0.97 (val F1 0.911), then the whole test split (1529 images) at 0.97. Single model, no TTA, no post-processing. Findings: full-res decoder matters for 1-2 px peaks; FPs are confident 1-2 px blobs far from labeled peaks (likely unlabeled weak peaks/hot pixels), min-size/closing post-processing did not help on val; higher thresholds did. Will be replaced by the final ensemble (smp Unet r34 + smp UNet++ r34 [+ team models], flip TTA) if it beats this on test with val-picked threshold.

S3DF evidence: jobs, training curves, logs, independent read-back

Detection (low priority): detection

Hugging Face RT-DETRv2 (PekingU/rtdetr_v2_r18vd, COCO-pretrained, 1-class head) on 256-px crops upscaled 2x; tiled full-image inference. Labels: one box per 8-connected component of label==1 (the peak mask), bounding box padded by 3 px per side (boxes ~7-16 px); no box labels exist in the dataset. Test mAP50 0.5830, precision 0.6711, recall 0.5203 on 1529 images. Checkpoint /sdf/data/lcls/ds/prj/prjcwang31/results/peaknet-seg-sprint/checkpoints/h8/det_a/best.pt, eval log /sdf/data/lcls/ds/prj/prjcwang31/results/peaknet-seg-sprint/evals/h8/det_a/eval.log.

Findings

  • 01:20-01:33 PST: every first training attempt died at the first convolution with CUDNN_STATUS_NOT_INITIALIZED. Cause: CUDA-13 wheels in the shared venv had overwritten torch's cu12 cuDNN/NCCL/cuSPARSELt (not GPU hardware). Fixed by reinstalling the cu12 pins (h1, log runs/h1/envfix/uv.log); runs relaunched 01:34-01:38. The FAILED/CANCELLED steps in the sacct capture are these attempts.
  • Labelled peaks are tiny (median 1-2 px, 4-35 peaks per 1920x1920 image; positive pixel fraction about 1e-6 to 1e-5). Models therefore use full-resolution heads (PixelShuffle or full-res decoders) and peak-centred training crops.
  • Detection (RT-DETRv2-r18, boxes derived from the masks): whole-test mAP50 0.583. Validation AP50 peaked at iteration 400 (0.584 on 120 val images) and collapsed afterwards (0.073 at 800, 0.016 at 1200) while training losses stayed flat, so the val-selected iteration-400 checkpoint is reported; a lower-LR + EMA retry was stopped to give its GPU to the best_model ensemble. Many detection false positives are true peaks whose predicted box is smaller than the 3-px-padded label box (IoU < 0.5).
  • h7 (best_model): false positives of the best segmentation model on test overlays look like bright spots indistinguishable from labelled peaks, i.e. likely unlabelled real peaks; precision may be capped by label completeness (Not verified).
